title: Hold working with children checks
what: Make sure people doing child-related work hold the state's working with children check (or equivalent).

sources.title: Working with children check
sources.publisher: Australian Business Licence and Information Service (ABLIS)
sources.quote: You will need a Working with Children Check if you are 14 years of age or over and you do: child-related work as a volunteer or employee for more than seven days a year any child-related work that involves overnight stays, or close personal contact with a child with a disability.
